reason: The reduced triclinic cell and a three-scatterer centrosymmetric average are strongly supported by peak positions and the custom profile fit, but the submitted exact realization is not sufficiently established. Its fully occupied inversion-related Hf pair has an extremely short 1.9207 angstrom Hf-Hf contact; the trajectory itself first identified this as a crystallographic subcell artifact, did not obtain a physically plausible full-cell solution, and then reinstated the short-contact model based on intensity agreement alone. The quoted 0.9914 is a correlation from a clipped, custom-weighted profile objective rather than a comparable Rwp, and the comparable whole-pattern report is unavailable. Thus the evidence supports the cell/average scattering framework more than the submitted symmetry, coordinates, multiplicities, and occupancies, while a materially different physical full-cell or split/alternative realization remains scientifically motivated.
